headline: PZ Cussons Nigeria Shareholders Approve N9.93 Billion Dividend
summary: Shareholders of PZ Cussons Nigeria Plc approved a final dividend payout of N9.926 billion for the 2026 financial year during its annual meeting.
why: PZ Cussons Nigeria is a leading consumer healthcare and personal goods manufacturer listed on the Nigerian Exchange.

impacts.name: PZ Cussons Nigeria
impacts.why: Approval confirms cash distribution of N9.926 billion to equity holders.
